{{Top|leg}}
A '''personal transponder''' was a communications device used to send a pre-arranged signal. [[Tait Ransom]] had intended to use a personal transponder to signal his crew while smuggling weapons and armor on [[Omman Minor]] but it was broken and failed to work as intended.
